messages:
maria g: Quick 1-min poll — favorite model codename? Pick one and also vote lunch: taco truck 🌮 or salad 🥗? Options: 1) Redwood-Raven, 2) Redwood-Fox, 3) Redwood-Owl, 4) Redwood-Titan. Vote like '2 + taco' or just emoji. I'll collect after 10min :timer_clock:
owen: 2 + taco
katie: 3 + salad
samir: 1 + taco :raised_hands:
lunchbot: Poll recorded: Taco truck (2), Salad (1), Models: Raven(1), Fox(1), Owl(1), Titan(0) — more votes welcome!
maria g: lol lunchbot doing the math for us :rofl: current quick tally — Raven:1 Fox:1 Owl:1 Titan:0; tacos 2 salads 1
owen: also random thought — love 'Raven' for model names, feels nimble
katie: Raven sounds ominous tho 😅 Owl is my vibe
samir: agree — Raven wins for me. Also I'm bringing extra napkins in case of taco emergency :sweat_smile:
maria g: ok final call: Raven it is. We'll use 'redwood-raven' in the demo. Lunch: taco truck wins. Anyone allergic to cilantro? @katie
katie: allergic to cilantro, but tacos without cilantro are fine!
maria g: noted. thanks all :tada:
